This historic site showcases the architectural styles of the Liao and Jin dynasties (907–1234), while also blending elements from the Tang (618–907), Song (960–1279), Ming (1368–1644), and Qing (1644–1911) eras.
A stunning example of traditional Chinese architecture, the temple continues to serve the present day, offering visitors the feeling of walking through centuries of China'
